about.en: Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corporation (SMIC) is China's largest pure-play semiconductor foundry, offering wafer fabrication together with design and backend turnkey services across analog and power, display driver, embedded and standalone non-volatile memory, mixed-signal and RF, IoT and automotive process platforms. Its shares trade on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange as 0981 and on the Shanghai STAR Market as 688981, and derivative markets quote the same equity under the SMIC ticker.
